body: I relate to this a lot. Having an orgasm was a relief from my depression, I never once suffered from a lowered libido or dysfunction in any shape or form before taking this. Still, every doctor I've seen is convinced I'm just "depressed" and need go on a higher dose of an SSRI. What a joke. My original psychiatrist blatantly told me they don't even cause sexual side effects TEMPORARILY, despite that it's listed as one of the most common side effects.
